Paper Cup Wall Types Explained: Single, Double and Ripple Wall

Article Quick Facts

Single Wall
2-32 oz, PE / PLA coating
Double Wall
8-20 oz, insulated
Ripple Wall
4-20 oz, premium grip
Coating Options
PE or PLA / water-based

Wall Construction Is a Sourcing Decision

For hot drinks, the paper cup wall is the difference between a comfortable hold and a cup that is too hot to carry. The listed paper cup range covers single-wall, double-wall and ripple-wall construction, each with its own capacity band and best use. Choose the wall type by the drink and the customer experience you want, then confirm the coating for your destination market.

Paper Cup Wall Type Reference

The table below uses the series, capacity, wall, coating and use fields from the paper and PLA cup category data.

SeriesCapacityWallCoatingUse
Single wall2-32 ozSinglePE / PLAHot & cold
Double wall8-20 ozDoublePE / PLAHot, insulated
Ripple wall4-20 ozRipplePEHot, premium grip

Single Wall: The Versatile Standard

The listed single-wall series spans the widest range, 2-32 oz, and is marked for hot and cold use. It is the cost-effective default for espresso sizes through to large cold servings. Single-wall cups are available with PE or PLA coating, so the same construction can be specified for either a conventional or a plastic-reduction market.

Double and Ripple Wall for Hot Drinks

Double-wall cups (listed 8-20 oz) add an insulating air gap for hot drinks, reducing the need for a separate sleeve. Ripple-wall cups (listed 4-20 oz) use a textured outer layer for extra grip and a premium feel. Both are oriented to hot service; confirm the exact size, coating and lid match for your menu before ordering.

Article FAQs

Which paper cup wall type is best for hot coffee?

Double-wall and ripple-wall cups are oriented to hot service, adding insulation and grip. Single-wall cups also handle hot drinks and often pair with a sleeve. Match the wall type to your drink temperature and handling needs.

What capacities are available for each wall type?

The listed ranges are single wall 2-32 oz, double wall 8-20 oz and ripple wall 4-20 oz. Confirm the exact size availability for your order.

Can paper cups use a compostable coating?

The listed single-wall and double-wall series offer PE or PLA coating; ripple wall is listed with PE. PLA or water-based coating suits plastic-reduction markets. Confirm the right coating for your destination.
